scenes.title: The Prisoner
scenes.biggestGap: Door is eased to a hand's width at the book reveal and never reopened before Sylvanas walks in and the open door is used as an escape route.

sceneContract.placeAnchor: storeroom doorway, door eased to a hand's width
sceneContract.povAnchor: Sylvanas takes the room by exits; the door is her exit count
sceneContract.dialogueAnchor: Cyndia's low voice and the book held in the crook of her arm
sceneContract.exitAnchor: Sylvanas pushes the door wide and walks into the light; the open door stays behind her
